name: Unnamed Project

entity_types.name: Politician
entity_types.description: Elected officials or political leaders involved in Thai or Cambodian domestic and foreign policy.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete name of the politician

attributes.name: political_affiliation
attributes.description: The political party or movement they belong to

attributes.name: current_office
attributes.description: The current position or role held in government

entity_types.name: Diplomat
entity_types.description: Officials representing their country in international relations and geopolitical negotiations.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete name of the diplomat

attributes.name: representing_country
attributes.description: The nation the diplomat represents

attributes.name: diplomatic_rank
attributes.description: The official rank such as Ambassador or Consul

entity_types.name: Activist
entity_types.description: Individuals leading social movements or protests regarding political frictions or human rights.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete name of the activist

attributes.name: cause_area
attributes.description: The primary focus of their activism, e.g., democracy, border rights

attributes.name: influence_level
attributes.description: Scale of their social media following or public reach

entity_types.name: Journalist
entity_types.description: Media professionals reporting on political events, border frictions, and regional security.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete name of the journalist

attributes.name: employer_org
attributes.description: The media outlet they work for

attributes.name: beat_topic
attributes.description: The specific area of reporting, e.g., Southeast Asian politics

entity_types.name: GovernmentAgency
entity_types.description: Official state departments responsible for foreign affairs, security, or border management.

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: The official name of the government department

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The functional area of authority

attributes.name: head_official
attributes.description: The person currently leading the agency

entity_types.name: PoliticalParty
entity_types.description: Organized groups that contest elections and influence national policy in Thailand or Cambodia.

attributes.name: party_name
attributes.description: The full name of the political party

attributes.name: ideology
attributes.description: The core political belief system of the party

attributes.name: country_origin
attributes.description: The country where the party operates

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet
entity_types.description: Organizations that publish news and influence public opinion through various platforms.

attributes.name: outlet_name
attributes.description: The name of the news organization

attributes.name: media_type
attributes.description: The format, e.g., Digital, TV, Newspaper

attributes.name: editorial_bias
attributes.description: The perceived political leaning of the outlet

entity_types.name: MilitaryUnit
entity_types.description: Specific branches or units of the armed forces involved in border security or internal stability.

attributes.name: unit_designation
attributes.description: The official name or number of the military unit

attributes.name: command_structure
attributes.description: The higher authority this unit reports to

attributes.name: base_location
attributes.description: The primary geographic area of operation

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: A fallback type for any natural person not covered by specific categories.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual

attributes.name: biography
attributes.description: Brief background information

attributes.name: citizenship
attributes.description: The country of citizenship

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: A fallback type for any organization not covered by specific categories.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: The industry or field of operation

attributes.name: headquarters
attributes.description: The city or country of the main office

edge_types.name: REPRESENTS
edge_types.description: Indicates a person acting on behalf of an organization or party.

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: Indicates a journalist or media outlet covering an entity or event.

edge_types.name: CRITICIZES
edge_types.description: Indicates public opposition or negative commentary.

edge_types.name: NEGOTIATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Indicates formal or informal diplomatic discussions.

edge_types.name: ALLIED_WITH
edge_types.description: Indicates a cooperative relationship or coalition.

edge_types.name: CONFLICTS_WITH
edge_types.description: Indicates friction, border disputes, or direct opposition.

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: Indicates the spread of opinion or pressure from one entity to another.

analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex geopolitical and domestic political landscape of Thailand and Cambodia. It focuses on key actors such as politicians, diplomats, and activists who drive social media discourse, alongside organizational entities like government agencies and media outlets that facilitate information propagation and institutional friction.
